title: Viking Vending
description:
Viking Trade SimulatorYou inherit a harbor and a humble trading post.
Each day, you purchase plunder from returning raiders—

axes, swords, shields, armor, runestones, mythical relics…

Satisfy Your CustomersCustomers arrive with specific requests:
Mandatory [Weapon] tags, preferred traits like [Fire] or [Sturdy] ,
and dreaded [Cursed] attributes they despise!
Select items from your inventory with precision—the more preferences you fulfill, the fatter your profit!

Island DevelopmentEarn coins to rebuild the Blacksmith for repairs and dismantling, construct the Shaman's Hut for enchantment and identification,
establish Lumber Camps and Mines for self-sufficient resources,
and even hire Raider Fleets to set sail for ~~plunder~~ treasure hunting!

Compendium CollectionGradually unlock the item compendium, collect mythical relics,
and make every last Viking your loyal customer!
description_short: Start with a Viking harbor at your command—buy low, sell high, and turn a tidy profit! Identify unknown treasures and strike it rich overnight! Rebuild the blacksmith's forge, enchant mighty artifacts, hire fierce raiders, and make every Viking your loyal customer!
